base_member_text: the crop to m=312, n=100 (L8-L9, L13) presumes depth_a15.txt is at least that large; the rip_tracking makebath.m produces n=100 rows (ncell=2, ycell=100, dy=2) and m=312 columns (x=-11..300, dx=1), so the 'crop' actually spans the whole array — hard-coding appears to be a workaround for the commented size() line (L7)

`dep` is created once before the loop at L13 and then destructively masked at L42. The active one-frame range hides the effect, but any restored multi-frame range would retain NaNs from every earlier mask and prevent re-wetted cells from returning in the depth panel.
